    How leaf colors are scaled

    Leaf colors are scaled relative to your saved topics: the lowest score is green, the highest is red, and scores between them blend through amber. Even small differences use the full color range. If all scores are equal, colors use the underlying score. Warning counts use a logarithmic scale from 0 to 1, capped at 4 warnings per video. Negative comments are divided by all rated comments for each video. Each measure is averaged across videos, then available measures get equal weight. Larger topics and popular videos do not automatically score higher. Missing analysis is excluded; gray means no usable data. Red means relatively stronger signals in this tree, not a diagnosis of harm. Review redder topics to decide what to prune. Click a topic for counts and analysis coverage, including child topics.
